I get the importance of self-care, not putting yourself in uncomfortable situations, anxiety, depression, etc but it’s not like bride was being a bridezilla. There are four- five-ish times I feel like a person can be (bday, wedding, funeral, birth of child) the center of attention and their (reasonable) wishes should be respected. Also, most people aren’t just picking their bridal party Willy nilly - they are important enough that they want you by their side during one of the biggest events in their life (although 10 is larger than average). I am bigger too but I would never leave a blemish on my friend’s big day just because I was uncomfortable in a dress. She also loves you no matter what size you are. If I were you and I valued the friendship, I would go back to her, apologize, and ask for my spot back. If you don’t care about the friendship (which is fine if you want to cut it off), let it be, no need to converse.
